articles.summary: Rivian reported a year-over-year increase in vehicle deliveries of 46% during the third quarter.

articles.title: Accenture stock rallies after earnings beat expectations
articles.summary: Shares of Accenture surged Thursday after the company's fiscal fourth-quarter results beat estimates.

articles.title: Nike shares drop as retailer posts disappointing sales, announces layoffs as part of restructuring
articles.summary: Nike is expected to post another quarter of declining sales as the company tries to turn around its business and regain growth in China.

articles.title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
articles.summary: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.

articles.title: We're raising our Micron price target after an incredible quarter and robust guidance
articles.summary: Micron signaled that fiscal 2027 will be another strong year as demand for its memory products continues to exceed supply.

articles.title: Costco makes progress on a key membership metric. Here's our new price target on the stock
articles.summary: Costco's membership renewal rates moved in the right direction. But the debate isn't totally settled just yet.
